title: India's Central Bank Backs Crypto Ban Amid Financial Risks and Tax Evasion Concerns
summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has reiterated its push for stricter controls on cryptocurrencies, citing financial risks and tax evasion concerns. Several government agencies favor a ban on virtual digital assets, although no clear regulatory framework has been finalized yet.
summary_points: India's central bank backs crypto ban
Financial risks and tax evasion concerns cited as reasons
Several government agencies favor stricter controls on cryptocurrencies
No clear regulatory framework has been finalized yet
Cryptocurrency regulation remains a topic of debate in India
